input.description: Test the CLI tool help output

state.output:
usage: proprietary-scanner.py [-h] [--filesystem] [--dirs DIRS [DIRS ...]]
                              [--output {table,json,csv}] [--verbose]

Scan for proprietary software on Linux systems

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --filesystem, -f      Scan filesystem for proprietary binaries
  --dirs, -d DIRS [DIRS ...]
                        Directories to scan (default: /usr/bin /usr/local/bin
                        /opt /home)
  --output, -o {table,json,csv}
                        Output format (default: table)
  --verbose, -v         Enable verbose output

Examples:
  proprietary-scanner.py                                    # Scan installed packages only
  proprietary-scanner.py --filesystem                       # Scan packages and filesystem
  proprietary-scanner.py --filesystem --dirs /usr/bin /opt  # Scan specific directories
  proprietary-scanner.py --output json                      # Output in JSON format
  proprietary-scanner.py --output csv > results.csv         # Save results to CSV file
